verdict.rationale: Docs mention that the API and AI-tool integration can 'triage findings' (gecko-security-docs-9, gecko-security-docs-10), implying some ability to change a finding's status, but there is no explicit documentation of marking findings as false-positive/baseline or suppressing them from future alerts, and no evidence of an ignore workflow. Community reports (gecko-security-comm-3) show false positives occurring but say nothing about whether they can be permanently dismissed. Missing for 10: explicit 'mark as false positive'/ignore/baseline feature, evidence that ignored findings stop triggering alerts on subsequent scans, and any UI/API documentation describing this workflow.
